definitions.short: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); by implication, to recline , repose , brood , lurk , imbed
definitions.usage: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
definitions.full: H7257. rabats רָבַץ verb stretch oneself out, lie down, lie stretched out (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Assyrian rabâƒu , lie, dwell ; rubƒu (in word-lists), stall , also womb (compare II. רבע above); Arabic lie down, on the breast, stretch oneself out , Sabean מרבצֿן CIS iv. no. 5, 2 ; רְבַע ᵑ7 lie stretched out , Syriac , Christian-Palestinian Aramaic recline at meals , Schw Idioticon 87 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ר Gen 49:9 , 3 feminine singular consecutive וְרָֽבְצָה Deut 29:19 , רָבָ֑צָה Ezek 19:2 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִרְבָּ֑ץ Isa 11:6 ; 27:10 ; 3 feminine singular וַתִּרְבַּץ Num 22:27 ; 3 masculine plural יִרְבְּצוּ 11:7 יִרְבָּ֑צוּ 14:30 יִרְבָּצ֑וּן Zeph 2:7 ; Psa 104:22 ; 3 feminine plural תִּרְבַּצְנָה Ezek 34:14 ; Participle רֹבֵץ Exod 23:5 3 t.; feminine רֹבֶ֫צֶת Gen 49:25 2 t.; masculine plural רֹבְצֹים 29:2 ; — lie down, lie: of domestic animals, ass Exod 23:5 (E; under heavy burden), Num 22:27 (Jeremiah; in obstructed path), Gen 49:14 (at ease; poetic, in simile); sheep, in repose, 29:2 (J), Isa 17:2 ; Zeph 2:14 ; figurative of people Ezek 34:14 ; calf. in repose Isa 27:10 : of wild beasts, lion, in lair, Gen 49:9 (poem in J; figurative), Psa 104:22 ; = make lair, abode Ezek 19:2 (figurative), so of צִיִּים Isa 13:21 , תַּנֵין Ezek 29:3 (figurative); leopard (with kid) Isa 11:6 , compare 11:7 ; = brood, of mother-bird Deut 22:6 ( עַלהָֿאֶפְרֹחִים ); of man, in repose Isa 14:30 ; Job 11:19 , compare Zeph 2:7 ; 3:13 (figurative of flock perhaps implied, compare Ezek 34:14 above); of the deep, תָּ֑חַת רֹבֶצֶת Gen 49:25 ; Deut 33:13 ; figurative of curse 29:19 ( ב person); of sin, רֹבֵץ חַטָאת לַמֶּתַח Gen 4:7 at the door sin makes its lair.
